basics.summary: I design backend microservices that process thousands of transactions a day in mission-critical healthcare environments. That end-to-end view lets me solve business problems, not just technical ones.

Legacy data migration with stored procedures and audit triggers, preserving integrity and traceability.
Authentication with Auth0, including account linking, and real-time features with WebSocket.
APIs documented with OpenAPI/Swagger; unit and integration tests automated in merge request pipelines.
Environments with Docker, Kubernetes (Tanzu) and Harbor, with CI/CD on GitLab.
Frontend with React and Vite; healthcare web applications with JavaScript and React, and a Vue healthcare monitoring system running in production for one of our clients.
Agile teams with Scrum; incident handling and prioritization.
